children: China aesthetic treatment platform's Q2 revenue rose 33% yr/yr, driven by branded center expansion
Net loss for Q2 narrowed yr/yr, reflecting improved operational efficiency
Company expects Q3 aesthetic treatment services revenue to nearly double yr/yr
So-Young expects Q3 2026 aesthetic treatment services revenue of RMB352 mln to RMB362 mln
Company plans to accelerate AI-powered transformation and strengthen supply chain
Company sees a clear path toward profitability as economies of scale continue to unfold
BRANDED CENTER EXPANSION - Co attributed revenue and treatment volume growth to expansion of branded aesthetic centers
USER GROWTH - Verified treatment visits and active users rose sharply, indicating strong demand and effective user acquisition
AI AND DELIVERY SYSTEMS - Management cited enhanced medical capabilities, standardized delivery system, and deeper AI integration as supporting efficient scaling
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the miscellaneous specialty retailers peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for So-Young International Inc is $7.30, about 204.2% above its August 28 closing price of $2.40
